study: Post-hoc matched-regularization sensitivity after the primary augmentation comparison
reason: Clean selection chose C=0.01 for the original control and C=0.1 for the augmented probe; assess whether the noise benefit also appears at equal C

endpoint: Error at 80% fractional-tie coverage, augmented minus clean within each C; all four combinations reported
